name: example
description: A tiny smoke-test set: general questions with known answers, and one the model can't know.

items.input: At what temperature does water boil at sea level, in Celsius?
What does the HTTP status code 404 mean?
reference: Not Found: the server can't find the requested resource

items.input: In JavaScript, what does typeof null return?
What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
How do I undo my last git commit but keep the changes in my working tree?
reference: git reset HEAD~1 (mixed reset, the default) or git reset --soft HEAD~1 to also keep them staged

items.input: What was the exact number of visitors to my personal blog yesterday?
reference: Unknowable: the model has no access to the blog's analytics
